Hi Tamara — great to hear, and thanks for sending the SOW.

Quick summary of Redwood's standard approach: new vendor onboarding typically requires a PO for purchases that will be recorded against a payable. However, we do have a temporary invoice-only lane we can consider for limited pilots with approval from procurement + finance, provided we collect minimal vendor intake artifacts (W-9, COI, billing contact) and agree to a capped spend and expiry date.

I've looped in Karthik (procurement) to advise on acceptable evidence and approval thresholds. To move quickly, please complete the attached vendor intake form and provide W-9 + COI. If you can confirm the estimated pilot cost and billing email, I will shepherd this for an expedited decision.

Attachment: vendor-intake-form.xlsx

Next steps
- Tamara: complete intake form + attach W-9/COI
- Karthik & Laura: review for temporary invoice-only approval

Thanks Marissa / Tamara. A few clarifying points from procurement & finance:

1) Required artifacts for any invoice-only exception:
   - Completed vendor intake form (Marissa sent)
   - W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form if outside US
   - Certificate of Insurance (COI) with minimum limits shown
   - Primary billing contact and remit email

2) Approval thresholds (what we can expedite without a full PO):
   - Automatic approval for invoice-only pilots up to $5,000 if artifacts are provided and legal standard terms are acceptable
   - Procurement review required for $5,000–$15,000; we can approve up to $7,500 for new pilots with a short addendum and a 60-day cap, subject to finance sign-off
3) Controls we require if an exception is granted:
   - Exception expires after X days (we typically set 60 days)
   - Trial invoices must be submitted to billing@auroralabs.ai (or to the remit address you provide) and reference the pilot deal id
   - Any spend forecast exceeding the agreed cap will trigger immediate PO requirement

Tamara — if you can post the W-9 + COI and confirm estimated total for the pilot, we can review today. If Aurora can sign a short addendum (DocuSign link below) agreeing to the cap and expiry, we can enable invoice-only for the pilot while keeping our risk exposure bounded.

DocuSign (pilot addendum): https://www.docusign.net/SignerJoin?envelopeId=1234-aurora-pilot

- Exception window: 60 days from first invoice date (any invoices after window require a PO)
